task: Be holding the key on at least two different moves, open the door and reach the goal.

value.feedback: CHANGES REQUIRED: The task only requires (1) holding the key on at least two different steps, (2) opening the door, and (3) reaching the goal. It does NOT state any ordering constraints. The candidate adds two hard Precedence clauses (has_key before door_open and door_open before at_goal) which are not mentioned in the language of the task; they are unnecessary because the environment already guarantees those orders. These are added requirements and must be removed. In addition, the hard Existence(door_open) clause is redundant: the combination of the required at_goal (which cannot occur before the door is open) already forces door_open, so this clause repeats what is already implied and should be dropped. Keep only the hard ExistenceTwo(has_key), the hard Existence(at_goal), and optionally a hard Existence(door_open) if you want it explicitly, but remove the redundant Precedence clauses and the redundant Existence(door_open) clause.
